why: The gap issue #226 names in its own words: 'the persistent top bar can leak gameplay status into application screens'. Everything left in that bar is in-match status now that the audio pair moved to Settings, so restoring the old rule puts the abandoned session's Lives, Enemies and Level chip above a menu offering to start a different match -- numbers about a world nobody is playing.
killedBy: hud: the topbar carries gameplay status only (issue #226) hides the whole bar at Launch and at the Main Menu, and shows it over the board
